label: PF Backlog 75
title: BUG: LLM client puts model REASONING into the artifact content (reasoning-only outputs)
body: Observed: stage-0a discovery-output.md (model nex-agi/nex-n2.5-mini:free) contains the model's raw chain-of-thought ('We need answer discovery doc... Need parse... We have no tools') rather than a document; 10547 reasoning tokens. The client appears to take the reasoning/first choice content instead of the FINAL assistant content. Fix in core/orchestrator/llm_client.py response extraction: prefer the final assistant message content; if the chosen field is reasoning, discard it; strip/【exclude】reasoning. Combined with BI-0034 (detect + retry empty/truncated/reasoning-only artifacts and never cache them) this prevents garbage artifacts from reaching downstream stages. Refs: core/orchestrator/llm_client.py _extract_response_content; BI-0034.
